description: This file is a header (.h) file providing function prototypes and include guards for the Network Interface (NIO) external API in a C/C project. It declares functions for creating network interface objects and related IP components, and includes licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: AnscCreateNetworkInterface
methods.description: Creates a network interface object with the given owner context.

methods.name: AnscCreateNioIp4
methods.description: Creates an IPv4 network interface object with the given owner context.
